claims: Opaque-only is implementation boundary, not source paint restriction.
Non-null transparent color retains alpha in initial glyph and bypasses theme fallback.
Initial radio dot is fill-only; later original generic SVG consumer may stroke it.
Runtime nonzero width writes path attributes; later zero retains last written width.
Runtime CSS replacement removes omitted-color overrides while transparent nonnull remains explicit.
Disabled attribute alone does not change supplied nonnull paint in these bounded routes.
limits: Transparent nonnull color data is retained by concrete solid fill getter and brush route; it is not a null theme request.
Theme values are labeled controlled inputs. Full theme, caller effective style and native rasterization not evaluated.
Zero border width does not enter either glyph method; geometry source b controls checkbox pen width.
Alpha is represented as explicit struct field payload; final SVG color serialization is separate.
